blogs.title: The Resurrection of the LSTM: Why xLSTM is Here to Challenge Transformers
blogs.description: Explore why LSTMs, once overshadowed by the Transformer revolution, are making a massive comeback. This post breaks down the three historical limitations of traditional LSTMs—rigid storage decisions, limited scalar memory, and lack of parallelism—and explains how xLSTM innovatively solves them to compete with today's largest AI models.

blogs.title: Inside the Black Box: Understanding sLSTM vs. mLSTM
blogs.description: Delve into the dual-engine architecture of xLSTM. Learn the distinct roles of sLSTM (scalar memory with exponential gating for revisiting stored info) and mLSTM (matrix memory with covariance updates for massive capacity). Discover how combining these two specialized blocks creates a powerhouse capable of handling complex language tasks efficiently.

blogs.title: Beyond Parallelism: How xLSTM Achieves Speed Without Sacrificing Accuracy
blogs.description: Address the biggest hurdle facing recurrent models: speed. This article demystifies how xLSTM maintains linear time complexity relative to sequence length while achieving performance comparable to Transformers. We discuss the trade-offs between memory mixing in sLSTM and the fully parallelizable nature of mLSTM, and why this matters for real-world inference speeds.

blogs.title: Scaling Up: Can LSTms Really Compete with Billions-Parameter Models?
blogs.description: Take a look at the experimental results proving that xLSTM isn't just a theoretical upgrade—it works at scale. From synthetic tasks requiring state tracking to massive 300B-token language modeling benchmarks, find out how xLSTM outperforms established giants like Llama and Mamba on perplexity scores and downstream reasoning tasks.
